bridge.narrative: Knight Institute and EFF join the May 8 civil-society amicus stack demanding a 60-day comment window, while Senators Warner, Young, and now Rosen lock the May 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing with NIST, ODNI, and CISA JCDC attending. OSTP confirms no signing window before May 22 — the political-operativeness condition hardens and the Q3 landing window holds.
bridge.remaining_gap: No EO text or Federal Register notice publishes today; OSTP's pre-May-22 floor pushes the artifact further right inside the Q3 frame.

bridge.narrative: South Korea's PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT signal intent to mirror the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity MoC under a 90-day consultation window, and New Zealand's GCSB joins Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC as observer with a Q3 mirror commitment. The recognition perimeter widens by two jurisdictions while OSTP confirms no FMRB signing before May 22 — the US gap sharpens.
bridge.remaining_gap: No US BIS rule, NIST AI Cyber Center artifact, or executive order publishes; foreign reciprocity hardens but the US executive surface remains absent.

bridge.narrative: Saturday post-trade reflection closes the empirical legs: Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and Citi hold Buy with $165-$185 targets while Bernstein initiates Market-Perform at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital concentration. CFO confirms the October 28 lock-up with no early waiver. The $27.2B fully-diluted cap exceeds the $22-25B band but the +18.3% open-to-close pop falls short of the >=30% bar.
bridge.remaining_gap: First-day pop magnitude undershoots the >=30% threshold; the valuation half lands above the band but the pop result does not clear.

bridge.narrative: Tenstorrent files a confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 with public window opening early August, retaining Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as $3.4B bridge co-anchors and adding Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity. SambaNova names J.P. Morgan and Citi alongside Goldman for a late-June S-1 at a $7-9B range; Groq trails 30-60 days. The continuation-play precondition hardens.
bridge.remaining_gap: SambaNova's $7-9B target sits below the $10B threshold; no second deal prices today, and Groq's sovereign-cloud closure remains pending.

bridge.narrative: Cerebras CFO's Saturday Q&A locks the October 28 180-day lock-up on OpenAI's $1B warrant with no early-release waiver — the first explicit public-company warrant-tenor confirmation. SEC Corp Fin's Saturday footnote elevates the May 8 sample comment letter to generally applicable guidance, putting warrant-tenor and sovereign-counterparty disclosure in front of Tenstorrent and SambaNova underwriters before pricing.
bridge.remaining_gap: SambaNova, Groq, and Tenstorrent S-1 exhibits have not yet posted; the disclosure standard tightens but issuer artifacts remain pending.

bridge.narrative: SEC Corp Fin's Saturday clarifying footnote elevates the May 8 sample comment letter to generally applicable guidance on AI-services-revenue measurement, removing the Reg FD overhang. Bernstein, Wells Fargo, and Evercore lift their probability of a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence into Q3-print territory; Alphabet's May 21 analyst day keeps the Gemini cost-of-revenue topic on the agenda.
bridge.remaining_gap: No Q2 10-Q with a discrete AI-services revenue footnote ships; staff guidance hardens but issuer-side filings remain ahead of the fiscal cutoff.

bridge.narrative: Day-two telemetry shows 13,800 published skills (+21%) and 891K installs; Mythos-class auto-quarantines climb to 22 with eight from JPMorgan, Booz Allen, and Mandiant tenants. Lockheed, Northrop, and Palo Alto Unit 42 sign the ethics-rider lifting the gated cohort to 41. Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex weekend interop updates extend signed-skill provenance across all three hyperscalers.
bridge.remaining_gap: Enterprise RFP language naming signed-skill registry as procurement default has not yet shipped; supply side overshoots but the buyer-side artifact remains pending.
